_warning: These tuples LOCK the CURRENT (fragile) line-POSITION bed heuristic (nums[-3]/nums[-2] of \b\d\b tokens after the address line). Several derived cards parse beds INCORRECTLY today because the comma in '£X,XXX' makes the thousands digit a standalone \b\d\b token that pollutes the nums array (the documented '3-bed-as-1-bed' / £5,600 class of bug). The assertions in TestKnightFrankParsing pin these EXACT current values; when the heuristic is fixed the test must be re-baselined (and the known-wrong beds annotations flipped). Do NOT 'correct' the tuples to the intuitive bed count without also fixing the spider.
